sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Reject: waterlineDisplacement is constrained and read on each UIWL node, but its authoritative requiredOwner is ship; do not place this property on iceWaterline or require a duplicated UIWL fact to equal the ship-owned displacementAtUpperIceWaterline operand. Preserve the explicit ship-to-UIWL selection relationship and greatest-displacement selection, but request and use the canonical cross-owner path that connects the selected UIWL displacement to the declared ship-owned operand, then use that selected value in the formula.
